sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Santosh Kumar Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mohd. Faiz Alam Khan,J.
1.

As per communication of the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ambedkar Nagar of date 26.09.2022,
opposite party no.2 has been served personally, however, she is not represented.

2. Heard learned counsel for the accused-applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
3.

This bail application has been moved by the accused/applicant- Kunal Yadav for grant of bail, in Case Crime No.130 of 2022, under Sections 376(2)(Jha), 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 of the P.O.C.S.O. Act,
Police Station Malipur, District Ambedkar Nagar, during trial.

4. Learned counsel for the accused-applicant while pressing the bail application submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case and he has not committed any offence as claimed by the prosecution.

1 5.

It is further submitted that F.I.R. of this case has been lodged by the victim herself on 02.06.2022 at Police Station Malipur, District Ambedkar Nagar alleging therein that on 02.06.2022 at about 08:30pm she had gone to the house of the applicant for the purpose of taking cold water from the refrigerator and at that point of time the applicant was present in the room and he after overpowering her started committing sexual assault and also threatened her of the life of her father and brother.

entities.text: Police Station Malipur, District Ambedkar Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It is also stated that on an alarm raised by the victim, mother of the applicant had opened the door and the applicant fled away from the room.

The allegations of sexual assault has been supported by the prosecutrix in her statement recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.
6.

Highlighting the above facts, it is vehemently submitted on behalf of the applicant that a small dispute pertaining to quarrel between the victim and applicant has been given the colour of sexual assault.

Attention of this Court has been drawn on the medical report of the prosecutrix, wherein no injury of any kind has been found on her person and her hymen has also been found intact and it is in this background, it is vehemently submitted that the theory of sexual assault as cooked up by the informant/victim could not be believed in absence of supportive medical evidence.
7. It is further submitted that age of the prosecutrix/victim is totally irrelevant in this case as allegation of sexual assault are prima facie false and could not be believed.
Attention of this Court has also been drawn towards the statement of one Smt. Sita, who is related to the applicant and has deposed of quarrel/altercation occurred between the prosecutrix and victim.

8. It is next submitted that applicant is in jail in this case since 04.06.2022 and he is not having any criminal history, charge-sheet in this case has already been submitted and there is no apprehension that after being released on bail the applicant may flee from the course of law or may otherwise misuse the liberty.

9. Learned A.G.A., however, opposes the prayer of bail of the applicant on the ground that sexual assault has been committed with a girl of very tender age and having regard to the material/evidence available against the applicant, he is not entitled to be released on bail, but could not controvert the other factual submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant.
10. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is evident that though age of the prosecutrix/victim was about 14 years at the date and time of the alleged incident,
however, in the medical report of the victim her hymen has been found intact.
In this background, it is submitted that allegations of sexual assault are prima facie false.
No injury of any kind has been found on the person of the victim while she was under medical examination.
Defence of the applicant appears to be that a small dispute/altercation pertaining to use of mobile phone has been given the colour of sexual assault on account of previous enmity.
Admittedly the incident had occurred in the house of the applicant, where allegedly the prosecutrix had gone to fetch some cold water from the refrigerator.
One of the witness, who is related to the applicant namely Smt. Sita, has narrated the incident as of quarrel between the prosecutrix and the applicant.
Charge-sheet in this case has already been filed.
Applicant is in jail in this case since 04.06.2022 without any previous criminal history.
The presence of the applicant could be secured before the trial court by placing adequate conditions.
Thus without commenting anything on the facts and circumstances of the case Kunal Yadav vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ...

2

as in the considered opinion of this Court the disputed questions of facts may well be adjudicated by the trial court, having regard to the period for which the applicant has already incarcerated in prison and medical report of the prosecutrix, the facility of bail in view of this Court may be extended to the applicant.

11. Having regard to the overall facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the considered view that applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is thus allowed.

12. Let the accused/applicant- Kunal Yadav involved in above-mentioned case, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
(ii) The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
13. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
14. Identity, status and residence proof of the applicant and sureties be verified by the Court concerned before the bonds are accepted.
15. Observations made herein-above by this court are only for the purpose of disposal of this bail application and shall not be construed as an expression of this Court on the merits of the case.

Order Date :- 19.9.2023 Anupam S/-
